24. § — Concentrations subject to notification

(1) A concentration shall be notified to the Competition Authority if:

a) the combined net turnover in Hungary of all undertakings concerned exceeds fifteen billion forints, and the net turnover in Hungary of each of at least two of the undertakings concerned exceeds five hundred million forints; or

b) the net turnover in Hungary of at least one other undertaking concerned exceeds fifteen billion forints.

Threshold values: HUF 15000000000 combined; HUF 500000000 per party.
